title: Rahab: an exploded planet that became the asteroid belt

tellings.quote: So, so the idea is that the the the asteroid field that the asteroid belt between uh Mars and Jupiter that that is the residue of a planet that exploded.

plain: A researcher named Tim Alberino describes the idea that the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter is 'the residue of a planet that exploded,' a lost world he links to the name Rahab, which appears in the Bible. He summarises it from the work of the writer David Flynn and draws on writings including the biblical Psalms and works titled Cydonia and Birthright. If true, it would mean an ancient world once stood where the asteroids now drift.
